bug_report:
[accepts-invalid] coroutines accepts prmomise type with both return_value() and return_void()
The standard says:

[dcl.fct.def.coroutine]

6. The unqualified-ids return_­void and return_­value are looked up in the scope of the promise type. If both are found, the program is ill-formed.


But gcc accepts such a promise type. Clang rejects it.
